subtitle: A content calendar your AI plans from your saved ideas.
about: A note with post dates, channels, progress and a list of ideas. Ask your AI to plan two weeks from those ideas, or add posts to the table yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the content calendar template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Add ideas
slides.you: Post ideas: a day in support, in numbers. Why we dropped the lifetime plan. A map of our first 100 users.

slides.label: Later, plan from them
slides.you: Plan the next two weeks: two LinkedIn posts and one newsletter.
slides.ai: Your three ideas are on the calendar, from Tue 24 Nov to Thu 3 Dec. The Ideas list is empty now.
slides.alt: The three ideas planned in the calendar

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.alt: Content calendar as it starts, ready to fill in
